name: Move Helper
author: byo-pop
description: H flashes a pair of animals you can join (in the puzzle, a swap that makes three), at any time, without waiting for the idle hint. H again plays that move for you, as two clicks. Not in the Stampede bonus round. Games with it keep their own high scores and saved game.

settings.label: A second H plays the move
settings.help: Off: H only shows a move, again and again; you play it yourself.
